name: interactive_tools
description: A terrain-profile plot with a clearly visible active gold ruler. Judge only content inside the plot; ignore toolbars, buttons, controls, headings, instructions, and other surrounding UI.

checks.expectation: One coherent terrain plot is visible. Its axes, grid, curve, and ruler stay within the plot area without unintended clipping. Do not evaluate the toolbar or any other content outside the plot.
A continuous terrain elevation profile spans most of the Distance (m) axis. The Elevation (m) axis, ticks, and grid are readable and visually aligned with the plot.

One active gold/yellow ruler is clearly visible over the terrain plot, with a ruler line, visible endpoint handles, and a visible distance label. Judge only whether it is present, recognizable, and clearly rendered. Do not judge its exact position, coordinates, length, slope, label value, or overlap with the terrain curve.

Within the plot, axis titles, tick labels, and the ruler label are readable and free of clear raster corruption. Fail only for concrete defects such as square pixel blocks, doubled glyphs, or severe stair-step edges that make plot text materially illegible. Do not compare plot text with headings, toolbar buttons, controls, or any text outside the plot. Normal antialiasing, small fonts, rotated text, and backend-specific softness are acceptable.
The blue terrain curve, gold ruler, axes, grid, and plot labels are visible; the plot is not blank, corrupted, or materially clipped.
